title: Passkeys explained: 36% of sign-ins at big services now skip the password
description:
Evergreen explainer: what a passkey is, how a passkey sign-in works, and why it beats phishing, anchored to the FIDO Alliance Passkey Index 2026, published October 15, 2026.

The numbers (FIDO Alliance Passkey Index 2026, 15 consumer services including Amazon, Google, Microsoft, PayPal, TikTok and WhatsApp; averages are unweighted):
- 36% of successful sign-ins now use a passkey, up from 26% in 2025. FIDO calls the comparison directional because the group of participants changed.
- 93% of passkey sign-ins succeed, vs 78% for passwords and traditional MFA.
- 27 seconds saved per sign-in on average, nearly three times faster.
- All 8 participants that measure phishing reported fewer successful attacks after deploying passkeys (no percentage given).
- At 8 of the 10 services reporting both figures, passkey sign-in share is still below enrolment.

What is a passkey? A secret key stored on your device, unlocked with the fingerprint, face or PIN you already use; it can sync across your devices, and there is no shared secret on the server (FIDO Alliance).
Why it beats phishing: the UK National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) calls all traditional MFA methods "inherently phishable"; passkeys remove the ability to cheaply reuse or relay credentials. In April 2026 the NCSC said passkeys should now be "consumers' first choice of login across all digital services".

Analyst note (Securidge analysis): a passkey only helps if you actually use it. If the old password stays the easy way in, that is what phishers will ask for.

Do this tonight
1. Add a passkey to your main email account first, because it can reset everything else.
2. Then your shopping and payment accounts.
3. When you sign in, pick the passkey.
4. Where a site offers no passkey yet, turn on two-step verification (NCSC advice).

Sources
- FIDO Alliance, Passkey Index 2026 (PDF, October 2026): https://fidoalliance.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Passkey-Index-October-2026.pdf
- FIDO Alliance, Passkey Index 2026 page (Oct 15, 2026): https://fidoalliance.org/passkey-index-2026/
- FIDO Alliance, Passkeys explainer: https://fidoalliance.org/passkeys/
- UK NCSC blog, "Passkeys are more secure than traditional ways to log in" (Apr 23, 2026): https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/blogs/passkeys-are-more-secure-than-traditional-ways-to-log-in
- UK NCSC, "Leave passwords in the past - passkeys are the future": https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/news/ncsc-leave-passwords-in-the-past-passkeys-are-the-future
- Biometric Update (Apr 24, 2026): https://www.biometricupdate.com/202604/uk-ncsc-formally-recommends-switch-to-passkeys-reversing-decades-of-guidance
- Start with Identity (Oct 15, 2026): https://startwithidentity.com/blog/2026-10-15-fido-passkey-index-2026-passkeys-reach-36-percent-of-sign-ins/

Narration uses an AI voice (ElevenLabs). Research, script and fact-check by Securidge.
